concept.title: Safeguards added to search
concept.shortdesc: Place, keywords, eligibility, an honest “nothing close” and crisis routing are applied alongside closeness of meaning.

dlentry.dd: A perfect match in Shropshire is no use to someone in Bristol.
Very short searches, such as “SEND” or “yoga”, are too vague to place well on the map. Conventional word matching runs alongside, and the two results are blended.
“Can my 15-year-old go?” is answered from the recorded ages and restrictions, not from similarity.
The nearest listing is not shown if it is not near enough.
A search that suggests someone is in crisis shows fixed, appropriate routes to help first, and not whichever community group happens to be nearest in wording.
